title: Bioinformatics Analysis of ZBTB16 as a Prognostic Marker for Ewing's Sarcoma.
authors: Ding, Ke; Qiu, Wenli; Yu, Dianbo; Ma, Huade; Xie, Kangqi; Luo, Fuqiang; Li, Shanlang; Li, Zaiyong; Wei, Jihua
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析筛选尤文肉瘤预后标志物ZBTB16，仅涉及差异表达和生存分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this study is to identify novel biomarkers for the prognosis of Ewing's sarcoma based on bioinformatics analysis. METHODS: The GSE63157 and GSE17679 datasets contain patient and healthy control microarray data that were downloaded from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database and analyzed through R language software to obtain differentially expressed genes (DEGs). Firstly, Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) functional enrichment, protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks, and Cytoscape Molecular Complex Detection (MCODE) plug-in were then used to compute the highest scores of the module. After survival analysis, the hub genes were lastly obtained from the two module genes. RESULTS: A total of 1181 DEGs were identified from the two GSEs. Through MCODE and survival analysis, we obtain 53 DEGs from the module and 29 overall survival- (OS-) related genes. ZBTB16 was the only downregulated gene after Venn diagrams. Survival analysis indicates that there was a significant correlation between the high expression of ZBTB16 and the OS of Ewing's sarcoma (ES), and the low expression group had an unfavorable OS when compared to the high expression group. CONCLUSIONS: High expression of ZBTB16 may serve as a predictor biomarker of poor prognosis in ES patients.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在基于生物信息学分析，识别尤文肉瘤预后的新型生物标志物。方法：GSE63157和GSE17679数据集包含患者和健康对照的微阵列数据，这些数据从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）数据库下载，并通过R语言软件分析以获得差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。首先，使用基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）功能富集分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络以及Cytoscape分子复合物检测（Molecular Complex Detection, MCODE）插件来计算模块的最高得分。经过生存分析后，最终从两个模块基因中获得核心基因。结果：从两个GSE数据集中共识别出1181个DEGs。通过MCODE和生存分析，我们从模块中获得53个DEGs和29个总生存期（overall survival, OS）相关基因。维恩图显示，ZBTB16是唯一下调的基因。生存分析表明，ZBTB16的高表达与尤文肉瘤（Ewing's sarcoma, ES）的OS之间存在显著相关性，且与高表达组相比，低表达组的OS较差。结论：ZBTB16的高表达可能作为ES患者预后不良的预测性生物标志物。
